findings.problem: Shared s0061 仕魏 clause assigns identical Western onOrBefore AD 266 bounds to Hu Zhi, Jiang Ji, and Zhu Ji without sentence-level years.
findings.action: Research each figure’s Wei service independently or store undated 仕魏 only; do not certify one bound for all three persons.

findings.problem: 質之為荊州也 narrative frame lacks explicit dating on s0063 (and related units for Hu Zhi’s posting).
findings.action: Pin Hu Zhi’s Jing tenure from external tables or keep event-only records; block Western AD 266 endpoints until sourced.
